gallery.heading: Rooms with intent — not a theme park floor
gallery.body: Each zone is sized for how members actually train: short walks between kit, sightlines kept low, and light that flatters effort instead of glare. These frames are from houses we admire; yours will be photographed on site after opening.
gallery.aside: Tours are private and unhurried. If you are comparing clubs, bring shoes — we would rather you feel the floor than read another brochure.
